data.narrative:
Sphere Semi is a Seed-stage semiconductor company founded by serial entrepreneur Steven Glinert (CEO) and Princeton PhD photonics researcher Mitchell Nahmias (CTO). The company has raised $20M to date. The Chips & Semiconductors sector contains 3 public comparables (ALAB, NVDA, AMD) and 8 private peers including Cerebras, Credo Semiconductor, and SambaNova Systems, though none provide sufficient datapoints at identical stage and valuation tier for direct peer median triangulation.

Given data limitations, Stage-Progression methodology applies most defensibly. Using $20M total raised as a baseline proxy and applying a typical 2.5x Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier yields an implied valuation of $50M. Public-Comp Anchoring cannot be applied without Sphere Semi's revenue figure, which is not disclosed. While the public semiconductor universe trades at a 20.4x P/S median, this cannot be operationalized here.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $42M–$57M, centered at $50M. Key uncertainties include the absence of narrow-set private peer data (no same-stage Chips & Semiconductors peers with comparable valuation available), lack of disclosed revenue, and limited visibility into the stage-progression multiplier appropriate for photonic and neuromorphic semiconductor subsectors specifically. The range rests on a single method; additional data on revenue trajectory or comparable seed-to-Series A outcomes in specialized chip development would materially refine this estimate.
